name: Vanilla Latte
caffeineNote: Printed on the can as 200 mg; the brand publishes no nutrition panel in text
summary: Zero-sugar vanilla cold brew on oat milk from the Holliston, Massachusetts brand. The can reads 200 mg of caffeine, 0 g of sugar and 80 calories in 11 fl oz, sweetened with sucralose instead. Loco publishes no nutrition panel in text — those figures are printed on the can in their own product photography.
